canonical_definition: OCR / Text Extraction refers to the capability of identifying and extracting textual content from visual inputs such as images or screens, often involving recognition of text in complex layouts or multimodal contexts. This behavior is typically evaluated through benchmarks like TextVQA, where accuracy metrics reflect the system's ability to read and interpret text within images for tasks ranging from question answering to UI navigation. Some papers frame it as a core component of vision-language models (VLMs) or multimodal instruction tuning, emphasizing its role in integrating visual and textual information.
